lines.text: The son must keep his father's commandment and bind it on his heart and tie it around his neck.
The commandment is a lamp, the reproofs of discipline are the way to life, keeping him from the evil woman.
The son must not lust for her beauty or be captivated by her wealth, for she preys upon his life.
A thief who is caught must pay back fourfold and give up all the wealth of his house.
The adulterer destroys himself, and the jealous husband will show no mercy and will not be appeased by any ransom.
